[[Silk Scrap]]s are tier five [[basic crafting material|basic]] [[crafting material]]s. Three scraps can be [[refinement|refined]] into a [[Bolt of Silk]] by [[Armorsmith]]s, [[Leatherworker]]s, [[Scribe]]s and [[Tailor]]s. They can be salvaged from level 58-80 [[light armor]].

== Acquisition ==
=== Contained in ===
{{contained in|columns=4}}

=== Salvaged from ===
* Level 58-80 [[light armor]]
{{salvaged from}}

=== Gathered from ===
* 33% chance when gathering from a [[Gathering#Resource nodes|Resource node]] in a level 71-80 area, using [[gathering tool]]s with a [[Glyph of the Tailor]] equipped.
{{gathered from}}

=== [[Map Bonus Reward]] ===
* Week 1 - [[Fireheart Rise]] - 10 total
* Week 2 - [[Cursed Shore]] - 10 total
* Week 3 - [[Frostgorge Sound]] - 10 total
* Week 4 - [[Mount Maelstrom]] - 10 total
* Week 5 - none
* Week 6 - [[Malchor's Leap]] - 10 total
* Week 7 - [[Straits of Devastation]] - 10 total
* Week 8 - [[Fireheart Rise]] - 10 total
